name: cdktn-bundler-harness
description: Ports known real-world bundlers (TerraConstructs local/nodejs/Docker, TerraConstructs PR #165 buildkit idea, PR #402 Rolldown) onto the IAssetBundler extension interface from open-constructs/cdk-terrain PR #442.

scripts.harness:docker: tsx src/run.ts --allow-docker --adapter=tcons-docker-bind --merge && tsx src/run.ts --allow-docker --adapter=tcons-docker-volume --merge && tsx src/run.ts --allow-docker --adapter=tcons-local-docker-chain --merge
